title: Transient transfection and purification of SARS-CoV-2 spike protein from mammalian cells
protocol: Prepare 800 mL of HEK293F cells at 2.0 × 10^6 cells/mL, with a viability of 95%-100% in a 2 L baffled bottom flask.
Dilute 2.25 mL of Turbo 293 transfection reagent into 37.5 mL of Opti-MEM I medium in a sterile container.
Incubate the diluted transfection reagent at room temperature (20°C-23°C) for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, dilute 750 μg of spike DNA into 37.5 mL of Opti-MEM I medium.
Add diluted DNA to the Turbo 293 complex by pouring gently down the side of the container wall.
Mix gently by swirling and incubate at room temperature (20°C-23°C) for 15 minutes to allow the formation of DNA-Turbo 293 complex.
Mix DNA-Turbo 293 complex with the 800 mL of cell culture in a tilted flask at approximately 45 degrees.
Gently swirl the cell culture flask to mix thoroughly.
Incubate the flask at room temperature (20°C–23°C) for 15 minutes.
Return the flask to an incubator set at 37°C with 9% CO2 and 120 rpm.
Warm FreeStyle 293F Medium in a 37°C water bath until warm, approximately 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Place Hyclone SFM4HEK293 medium at room temperature (20°C–23°C) for about 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Add 80 mL of Hyclone Medium to the cell culture flask and gently swirl to mix.
Add Freestyle 293F medium to the cell culture flask until the volume reaches 1 L, then gently swirl to mix.
Return the flask to an incubator set at 37°C with 9% CO2 and 120 rpm for 5 more days.
Divide 1 L cell culture into two 500 mL conical tubes.
Centrifuge at 4,000 × g for 30 min at 22°C.
Filter supernatant with a 0.20 μm filter.
Replace the filter if flow slows down or stops.
Discard water left on the Vivaflow 200 membrane.
Place input and output tubing into the filtered supernatant using new sterile aspiration pipettes.
Concentrate filtered supernatant with Vivaflow 200, 100K MWCO device until volume is around 100 mL.
Increase peristaltic pump speed to setting 5 or as needed to keep pressure gauge at a maximum of 3 bar.
Lower the speed and rinse the membrane with approximately 20–50 mL of filtrate.
Empty concentrator after rinsing.
Elute bound protein by pouring 40 mL of Buffer E at a time.
Collect fractions of approximately 40 mL.
Continue pouring elution buffer on the column until absorbance at 280 nm reads 0 on UV-VIS spectrophotometer.
Stop collecting fractions when characteristic spike denaturation profile is no longer observed with Differential Scanning Fluorimetry.
Perform DSF assays using Tycho NT. 6 (NanoTemper Technologies).
Check all elution fractions for typical spike profile characteristics.
Place capillary into 10 μL of elution fraction sample.
Securely place capillary in slot and close holder.
Start the measurement.
Identify elution fractions with absorbance at 280 nm above 0.00 or with a characteristic spike DSF profile.
Concentrate identified fractions using an Amicon Ultra centrifugal concentrator with a 100 kDa molecular weight cutoff (MWCO) at 22°C, following the manufacturer’s instructions.
Inject 500 μL sample on a Superose 6 Increase 10/300 column using a Hamilton syringe.
Concentrate peak fractions using an Amicon Ultra centrifugal concentrator with a 100 kDa molecular weight cutoff at 22°C, following the manufacturer’s instructions.
Prepare single-use aliquots of the concentrated sample.
Flash freeze the aliquots with liquid nitrogen (LN2).
Store the flash-frozen aliquots at -80°C.
Thaw the frozen sample aliquot at 37°C for approximately 20 minutes when needed.
Keep the thawed sample at 22°C while working.
Prepare three 10 μL aliquots of freshly purified S protein at a concentration of 0.1 mg/mL.
Run triplicates on NanoTemper Tycho for differential scanning fluorimetry (DSF).
Perform SDS-PAGE analysis to check the quality of the purified S protein before use in experiments.
Prepare reduced and non-reduced samples with 3 μg of protein each for SDS-PAGE analysis.
Prepare reduced samples by mixing 3 μg sample, 2.5 μL 4× Laemmli sample buffer, and 3 μL 1 M DTT, bringing the volume to 10 μL with gel filtration buffer.
Prepare non-reduced samples by mixing 3 μg sample and 2.5 μL 4× Laemmli sample buffer, bringing the volume to 10 μL with gel filtration buffer.
Place NuPage 4%–12% Bis-Tris gel in the Invitrogen Mini Gel Tank.
Fill the mini gel tank with 1× NuPAGE MES SDS Running Buffer up to the fill line (total volume of 400 mL per side).
Remove the comb and load 10 μL of sample into each well.
Run the gel at 200 V for approximately 30 minutes until bands reach the bottom of the gel.
Stain the gel with Coomassie blue for 20 minutes.
De-stain the gel with DI water until bands are prominent.
